title: bar_row/v1
description: One OHLCV bar as a JSONL line inside a pack series file. The same row shape serves all three never-conflated price series (trade, mark, index); the series role is declared file-level in pack_manifest.files[].role, so rows carry no per-row schema field (bulk-data exception to the self-description rule; see VERSIONING.md). All prices are integer ticks (multiply by the market's tick_size_micro for micro-quote units). All timestamps are real UTC epoch-milliseconds in pack files; the observation builder rebases them before an agent ever sees them.

available_at.description: Instant this row becomes observable = bar CLOSE time (ts + bar interval), UTC epoch-milliseconds. The point-in-time isolation key: an observation at virtual clock T may include only rows with available_at <= T (ISO-1). Stored per-row (not derived) so leakage property tests and the poison-row fixture operate on stored bytes.

o.description: Open price in integer ticks (tick size in the pack manifest's market descriptor, tick_size_micro).

h.description: High price in integer ticks. On the mark series this drives the intra-bar liquidation check for shorts (MATH-3).

l.description: Low price in integer ticks. On the mark series this drives the intra-bar liquidation check for longs (MATH-3).

v_base_1e8.description: Bar volume in 1e-8 base-asset units (e.g. satoshi for BTC). Feeds the participation cap on the trade series; 0 is permitted and expected on mark/index series (one row shape, three streams, one parser).
